function path(points){let d=0;const p=[{...points[0],d:0}];for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++){const inc=distance(points[i],points[i-1]);if(inc<.015)continue;d+=inc;p.push({...points[i],d});}return {points:p,length:d};}

  }}
